hero.h1b: Chiibitsu Labs exists to close that gap.

items.title: Startup Weekend
items.body: A first taste of entrepreneurship as a path open to anyone, not a title earned after years on a ladder.

items.title: Mobility
items.body: Beep a Ride became an extra income path for drivers when platform economics were easy to misread.

items.title: Blockchain
items.body: What I learned early became community education and mentorship, never a private advantage.

items.title: AI
items.body: Now: helping businesses use AI to strengthen judgment and the way work gets done, not to create busywork or tool dependence.

waves.h: I have watched the gap open many times
waves.caption: These four shaped this company

cards.today: Every decision still ends up on your desk.
cards.after: Decisions your team can make without you, and the standards that make them safe to make.

cards.today: Everyone uses AI their own way, and nothing sticks.
cards.after: Two or three workflows your team can run on Monday.

cards.today: The things only you know, stuck in your head.
cards.after: Written down where the team can actually find them. The moat that stays when people leave.

cards.today: Every vendor says yes. Nobody decides.
cards.after: A decision you can defend, and the reasoning behind it on paper.

longBet.h: Science moves because labs share what they learn.
longBet.hEm: A future-forward business helps move humanity forward.
longBet.body: What your company knows stays yours. What it learns can lift everyone who comes after. That is the long bet.

steps.title: Understand the choice
steps.body: What is really being decided, and what it costs.

steps.title: Map the real workflow
steps.body: How work actually gets done, not how the chart says.

steps.title: Incorporate the disruption
steps.body: Put AI where it gives real leverage.

steps.title: Leave capability behind
steps.body: Your team runs it and adapts it without me.

choice.h: There is no one right answer to technological change.
choice.hEm: I show you the paths. You choose.
choice.body: Every path has costs, risks and trade-offs. I make them visible, then build the workflows, knowledge and systems for the choice you make.
choice.alt: A path splitting into three, each with its own cost
